title: DHS Sivagangai Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for 02 Coordinator and Driver Posts
description: District Health Society Sivagangai (DHS Sivagangai) has officially released a notification for the recruitment of 02 Coordinator and Driver Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in the Post Graduation, 10th Pass can grab this chance and apply for the DHS Sivagangai Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply offline before the last...
